review: V2 derivative-noise-reference thresholds substantially reduce small-scale noise detections. Visible dark compact pores, including some on boundaries, retain responses. Junctions, small dark grains and phases remain confounders. No pore truth is claimed. One fixed22-feature panel is reasonable to evaluate.
one_label_blind_revision: V1 fixed .01 detected excessive noise; v1 QA and source preserved. V2 max(.01,3*HHnoise*kernelL2), no variance subtraction, no roundness exclusion gate. No further feature/threshold changes after this freeze.
fixture_interpretation: Attached-pore central response/isolated1.00031; ideal ridge/isolated0.000535. Synthetic Gaussian fixtures test algorithm behavior only, not accuracy on all real pores; never used as training data.
